SUPERSESSION / OWNERSHIP MIGRATION RECORD — v1.8 RECOVERY CANDIDATE

Status: RECOVERY_CANDIDATE. Newest explicit Lucas decisions override older conflicts. Historical definitions remain provenance.

1. AOS
OLD/CURRENT-HISTORICAL: persistent autonomous execution identity/service.
CURRENT: AOS is predecessor to CONDUCTOR and SUPERSEDED as a current authority. Preserve execution concepts as lineage; do not resurrect AOS as a peer.

2. HEIMDALL
HISTORICAL: broad universal library/media/reading/photo/conversion/information environment.
CURRENT: Doorway to EDEN; ORGANIZE · UNDERSTAND · ACCESS · COMPOSE; Workspaces/context/information composition; universal discovery/access; Custom Apps; HEIMDALL.CONDUCTOR. Historical specialist functionality must be ownership-audited before restoration.

3. SKALD
CURRENT: standalone Media & Entertainment/media-content specialist App. Historical HEIMDALL media-center requirements migrate to SKALD where still applicable, including Transmission/torrent intake, subtitle/media-processing, safe remux, media naming/reconciliation and entertainment-library concerns.

4. LECTOR
CURRENT: professional Books & Reading specialist. Historical HEIMDALL reading/Calibre-facing user experience migrates to LECTOR where applicable. Shared provider/object capabilities may remain independently reusable.

5. CURATOR
CURRENT: professional photography/media-management specialist. Historical HEIMDALL professional photo-management requirements migrate to CURATOR where applicable.

6. CHRONOS
CURRENT: reserved temporal/time specialist identity; functionality may be described, but expansion/personality/authority/implementation are not yet canonical.

7. TINY HELPERS
CURRENT: some identities intentionally exist only as names/descriptions. Undefined need is not missing recovery. Do not invent roles.

8. LCAS
CURRENT: in-Chat Live Control, Activity & Status presentation identity only. Apps/edenOS use actual UIX + truthful state contracts.

9. CONDUCTOR
CURRENT: HEIMDALL-owned, EDEN-wide conversational/voice/command capability; deterministic/offline baseline; voice independent of AI/cloud; incorporates relevant recovered governance/lineage concepts without making voice an owner.
